problem: Need test a trainable bag/current-observation representation and a relative-observation objective on actual fresh A100 features before launching a quality study.
inputs: Identical fresh three-anchor PCD, current anchor, normalized box/time metadata and same own actual teacher answers. No future-video statistics or labels.
model_principle: A candidate TrackID is a bag, not certified physical identity. Separate support somewhere in the bag from current selection. Frame No is not a bag-negative or per-attribute negative label.
objective: Confidence-weighted Bernoulli teacher loss plus optional weight1 conditional-choice KL within same query/bag/effective-view. The common support factor cancels directly; shared context paths can still learn.

fixed_optimization.continued_optimization: Failed contextual models get up to10blocks x100LBFGS iterations in float64, same architecture; verify deployedfloat32. Ordinary gets its existing teacher-only adequate-capacity continuation.

fairness: Flat ordinary receives all three state vectors and current features. Direct-context controls use the same learned pooling/context as the conditional model, both with and without relative loss.
label_scope: CLIP responses assigned to requested anchors as a common prototype approximation, not certified frame truth. No language-scope cache consumed yet.
partial_identification: Bag support is not uniquely recovered from sparse probabilities; no claim that a learned latent factor is true semantic identity or a clothing attribute.
measurements: Actual deployed teacher CE/KL, conditional-choice KL, convergence/remainingfailures, realGPU fitting time and input index handoff.
scientific_acceptance: This is an optimization/dataflow pilot only. Completion or teacher-fit PASS is not a module contribution or six-setting success.
